_comment: Category -> Pinterest board ID. Not secret (an ID, not a credential), so this lives in the repo rather than .env — same reasoning as wrangler.jsonc's RESEND_AUDIENCE_ID. Find a board's ID via the Pinterest API (GET /v5/boards) or the board's page source; the board's URL slug is NOT its ID. Leave a category blank to fall back to PINTEREST_BOARD_ID (a single catch-all board) for that category.
